notes.title: Update 0.0.427 – Simplified Weapon Interaction
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320367/a5efa5ab72a64c4d5b01430c83e1e07c789454de.jpg

The weapon interaction system has been completely overhauled. Now, to pick up a weapon, simply bring your hand close to the grip and press the left mouse button (grab). Reloading and disengaging the safety work the same way. Additionally, you can now seamlessly switch the weapon from one hand to the other.

For now, all maps will feature the AK-12 assault rifle and the PL-15 pistol. More weapons will be added in the future.

We look forward to your feedback in the comments and on our Discord!

notes.title: Update 0.0.383
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=vEFMh41SJcg;full][/previewyoutube]
In this version of Hand Simulator, you no longer need to hold your weapon correctly to shoot with your index finger. Just grab the gun, move forward, and press the right mouse button — if everything is loaded and the safety is off, the shot is guaranteed.

What's New:

 Added all character and hand control buttons to the control settings.
 Fixed hand inversion settings — they simply didn’t work before.


Near-Future Plans:

 Simplify weapon handling so anyone can pick up a gun, load it, and jump straight into battle.
 Introduce a weapon economy in "Team Deathmatch" and "Elimination" modes.
 Optimize maps, weapons, and soldiers.
 Add hit effects.
 Add targets to the training mode.


Once we refine hand control and players stop complaining that it's unmanageable garbage, we’ll move forward:

 Introduce "Capture the Flag" mode.
 Add vehicles.
 Expand the weapon arsenal.


💬 Got ideas or feedback? Post in the community — we read everything!
